Admin.page_subtitle: Review and maintain model capabilities, permission assignments, and feature flags in one place. This version focuses on the core business configuration domains needed before production rollout.
Admin.sections_subtitle: Jump directly to models, permissions, feature flags, and audit.
Admin.models_subtitle: Review model capabilities, upload policy, and visibility before moving more settings into admin management.
Admin.permissions_subtitle: Current per-user permission assignments controlling admin access, GPT management, and other business capabilities.
Admin.flags_subtitle: Product-level configuration that can gradually replace business-oriented environment variables.
Admin.assistant_defaults_subtitle: Pull the most frequently changed runtime defaults for the main assistant out of generic JSON flags and manage the default model, visible models, and default reasoning here.
Admin.assistant_defaults_default_model_descrip: Runtime default model for the gptassistant assistant.
Admin.assistant_defaults_default_visible_model: Default visible model list for the gptassistant assistant.
Admin.assistant_defaults_visible_models_hint: Use commas to separate model IDs, or click the model pills below.
Admin.assistant_defaults_default_reasoning_des: Whether gptassistant should enable reasoning by default.
Admin.assistant_defaults_default_reasoning_hin: This updates both the chat runtime default and the assistant detail response.
Admin.product_flags_subtitle: Promote the high-frequency product switches that directly affect entry visibility and capability exposure into explicit forms instead of raw feature flag editing.
Admin.product_flags_gpts_description: Controls whether GPTs entry points and APIs are open to the product.
Admin.product_flags_gpts_hint: When disabled, regular users lose the GPTs entry and related backend APIs continue to reject access with the existing logic.
Admin.audit_subtitle: Recent administrator configuration changes so the team can see who changed what and when.
